index.INDEX.md:
# Index

## Cross-cutting chains

| Change | Paths it touches |
|---|---|
| Add or change a part | `parts/`, `workspace.json`, `docs/parts.md`, `README.md` |
| Add a page | `docs/layout.md`, `INDEX.md` |
| Change the engine | `wslib/`, `workspace.json`, `CHANGELOG.md` |

## Elsewhere

| Change | Paths it touches |
|---|---|
| Not a chain | `notes/` |
